Name: TPs Wizard Character_Portrait Longhood.ver_Vanilla.LFL.SVE.RRRR
Author: Tampey
Description:
This is a portrait of a wizard.
I drew it in two versions.

No hood long style/hood long style.
You can add a portrait by selecting it.

Only the portrait is different and the character itself is the same.

[u][b]These download files don't have a manifast.json file. You have to find and add the path file yourself.

[/b][/u]

How to install

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod 
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[/list]
Can use both Portraiture and PortraiturePlus . I usually use Portraiture, and I can't explain this because I don't use Portraitureplus (Because I don't know how to it)

If you have any problems with this file, please let me know. Feedback is welcome :)

SVE's Portrait need to change file name. (Magnus > Wizard)

Please put the character files in the order of the files in the mod.
